title: Certify a maximal two-digit compact guard with 64 fewer repairs (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Finite optimal-guard certificate and scoped written repair proof for the unchanged later-source compact word at `n=2, K=3, G=1, rho=2`. This answers one small multi-digit instance of Arham Tahir's PR1603 open question.

```diff
- PR1603 carry guard H: 2368 accepted states; 5824 exceptional records
+ H OR (c=0 AND t=1 AND u=2 AND quotient y odd): 2432 accepted; 5760 exceptional
```

The added 64 states are exactly one cancellation branch. The two raw subcalls reverse each other's displacement despite an incoming compact carry excluded by H. The new guard is the largest invariant agreement subset of this complete 8192-state quotient. Good density grows from 37/128 to 19/64; the exceptional coefficient falls from 91/128 to 45/64. This is not a new kappa or a production parameter claim.

Only `research/compact-maximal-invariant-guard/` is added. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Arham Tahir / Arham-Tahir64 #1603 for H and the open question; Aaron Wang / navinor #1823 for raw-agreement context; woklerx #1856 for full-modulus context; Douglas Colkitt for the unchanged word and repair contract; Hanson Sun #1247/#1219, Sagar Thakrar #1475, John-Michael Smith #763, martinxxx9 #1108 and the retained compact-control lineage. The general involution-core observation remains credited prior work. No predecessor mathematical executable is imported or replayed.

## Evidence

Before, #1603 gives an all-n sufficient guard and one-digit maximality. After, the written branch calculation and complete finite cycle certificate supply a strict multi-digit enlargement and its exact optimum for one geometry.

- Both warning-strict normal and optimized CPython 3.12.15 checks pass locally on macOS 27.0.1 arm64, with identical generated source-bound receipts. They took 0.105 and 0.104 seconds under their 60-second caps. These are timeout observations, not a speedup claim.
- All 32768 full-target states, including every low-bit lift and upper target bit, agree with a separate quotient implementation. All 8192 quotient states enter the literal permutation and cycle-maximality check; every added state has the stated branch form.
- Tagged current-address repair sends all 8192 distinct payloads to their intended outputs while extracting precisely 5760 records. Incorrect current keys misplace all 5760 exceptional payloads and are rejected. Agreement-only guards, three deleted branch conditions and seven invalid inputs are checked.
- Registered metadata/pins and both commands pass. In-memory compilation and whitespace checks pass. Committed-byte and declared-source-history checks pass at `2ded88c270fdaeec2bada34087dcfaa86eefadb2` for all eight package/input files.
- Official committed export integrity and both declared inputs pass. Normal and optimized read-only Git-free replay with empty PATH pass, with all nine exported files unchanged. Receipts are generated stdout, not handwritten.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/compact-maximal-invariant-guard/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/compact-maximal-invariant-guard/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/compact-maximal-invariant-guard
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/compact-maximal-invariant-guard --check-source-history
```

Substitute another CPython 3.12 path elsewhere. Expected markers are `PASS_COMPACT_MAXIMAL_INVARIANT_GUARD`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Maximality is a finite certificate for this one geometry. The extra branch has zero processed source bits. No improvement on nonzero source slices, production families or an all-n agreement classification is established. Raw agreement counts alone remain insufficient for an invariant repair envelope.

The inherited repair expression remains `O(V + M L^3 + delta M L(P+L))`. All twelve compact swaps, ten rotations and highest-bit completion stay paid. The tagged sort is a logical record permutation. Physical tape lowering, native supply, stock/ownership, compiler, precision and analytic transfer remain unproved. No selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run, complete multiplication theorem, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can a bounded symbolic carry description supply an invariant enlargement containing nonzero processed source slices? Start with one additional complete geometry and retain the full target modulus. A finite-state bound, physical guard implementation and complete caller bill remain missing.

## Related open work

No open PR computing this maximal invariant later-source guard or this quotient's optimum was found in the refreshed lists, targeted main/merged searches and Discussion claims. Merged #1603 supplies the direct question, while merged #1823/#1856 concern raw agreement and its carry defect. The overlap snapshot covers 387 open PR bodies, 6322 Discussion records and all 8917 tracked local notes; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside that text coverage.

At completion, the titles and bodies of all fourteen other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM were checked: #6437 through #6451, excluding this PR #6445. None studies this guard or computes a competing value for this same quotient. No additional computations were run to audit those contributions.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at head `2ded88c270fdaeec2bada34087dcfaa86eefadb2`: `plan` and `replay (research/compact-maximal-invariant-guard)`, in [run 41544198312](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41544198312). The completed check list was read once. Run metadata confirms conclusion `success` and the matching head. Hosted replay certifies the registered finite checks and source bindings; the scoped written argument remains outside a formal proof kernel. All registered commands and publication/export checks also passed locally.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362365
